record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: Construct the minimal free resolution G when G resolves a lex ideal over a quotient ring such as a Veronese ring or a Segre ring.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field and let $S = k[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ be the standard graded polynomial ring. A monomial ideal $L \subset S$ is called a lex ideal if for every monomial $m \in L$ and every monomial $m'$ of the same degree as $m$ with $m' >_{\mathrm{lex}} m$, one has $m' \in L$ (here $>_{\mathrm{lex}}$ denotes the lexicographic order with $x_1 > x_2 > \cdots > x_n$).

Consider a standard graded $k$-algebra quotient $R = S/J$ where $J$ is one of the following:
(i) the defining ideal of a Veronese ring, i.e., $R$ is the $d$-th Veronese subring $k[x_1,\dots,x_n]^{(d)}$ presented as a quotient of a polynomial ring by its toric relations, for some integers $n \geq 2$ and $d \geq 2$; or
(ii) the defining ideal of a Segre ring, i.e., $R$ is the Segre product $k[x_1,\dots,x_a] \# k[y_1,\dots,y_b]$ presented as a quotient of a polynomial ring by the $2 \times 2$ minors of a generic $a \times b$ matrix.

Let $\overline{L}$ denote the image in $R$ of a lex ideal $L$ (with respect to a chosen monomial structure on $R$). Explicitly describe, in closed combinatorial form, the minimal graded free resolution $G_\bullet$ of $R/\overline{L}$ as an $R$-module: in particular, give formulas for the graded Betti numbers $\beta^R_{i,j}(R/\overline{L})$ and the differentials of $G_\bullet$, for every lex ideal $\overline{L}$ in the quotient ring $R$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of explicitly constructing minimal free resolutions of lex ideals over Veronese or Segre quotient rings appears to remain open. Surveys on infinite graded free resolutions and on Hilbert functions over toric rings (e.g., work by Gasharov–Horwitz–Peeva and the McCullough–Peeva survey) describe partial results for certain toric/quotient rings but do not provide a general explicit minimal free resolution for lex ideals over Veronese or Segre rings.

status_evidence.title: Infinite Graded Free Resolutions (McCullough–Peeva)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on infinite graded free resolutions, including resolutions over quotient rings; explicit minimal resolutions are known only in special cases.
status_evidence.claim: General explicit minimal free resolutions of lex ideals over Veronese/Segre quotient rings are not provided; the topic is presented as an active research area.

status_evidence.title: Hilbert Functions over Toric Rings (Gasharov–Horwitz–Peeva)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies lex-like ideals and Hilbert functions over toric rings such as Veronese rings, providing partial structural results.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for lex ideals over toric rings, but a general construction of the minimal free resolution is not given.
